issues.t: Loss of drive power from engine software (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights come on and the SUV may lose drive power while moving.
issues.why: Faulty software in the powertrain and engine control computers can put the vehicle into a fail-safe mode. Mazda recalled about 31,500 vehicles, the 2024 CX-90 and 2025 CX-70, to reprogram them.
issues.next: Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and get the free update. Until then, treat any warning light seriously and pull over safely if power drops.

issues.t: Loss of power in EV mode from inverter software (recall)
issues.sym: While driving on electric power, warning lights come on and the SUV can lose drive power.
issues.why: The plug-in hybrid inverter, which feeds power to the electric motor, had software that could fault. Mazda recalled about 14,900 2024 CX-90 and 2025 CX-70 plug-in hybrids for improved software.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free inverter software update. If power drops, use your hazard lights and get off the road.

issues.sym: The fuel gauge or miles-to-empty shows more fuel than is really in the tank, so the SUV can run out of gas and stall without warning. Some owners had no-starts.
issues.why: Body control computer software can display the wrong fuel level. Mazda first issued a service alert, then recalled about 105,000 2024-2025 CX-90 and 2025 CX-70 mild hybrids.
issues.next: Get the free software update. Until it's done, track miles between fill-ups and don't let the tank run low.

issues.t: Defroster, seat belt chime or 360 camera may not work (recall)
issues.sym: When you start the SUV, the windshield defroster, seat belt reminder, or 360-degree camera may not work. On plug-in hybrids the high-voltage battery cooling may not run properly.
issues.why: The dash electrical supply unit, which powers these systems, has a software problem. Mazda recalled about 80,900 2024-2025 CX-90s and 2025 CX-70s.
issues.next: Get the free reprogramming. A defroster that doesn't work is a visibility risk in cold or wet weather, so don't drive until the glass is clear.

issues.t: Hybrid System Malfunction warning with power loss
issues.sym: A "Hybrid System Malfunction" message with warning lights and chimes, sometimes followed by a sudden loss of power, stalling at a stop, or EV mode not working.
issues.why: Several software recalls cover this on the plug-in hybrid, and owners report problems that come and go. The exact cause is not always found.
issues.next: Make sure all recalls and software updates are done. If it comes back, write down the message and when it happened, and have the dealer read the stored codes. Pull over safely if power drops.

issues.t: Jerky or hesitant shifting at low speed
issues.sym: Jerks, hesitation or a sluggish feel when pulling away from a stop or in stop-and-go traffic. One owner reported the transmission briefly losing drive at highway speed.
issues.why: The CX-70 uses an 8-speed automatic with a clutch pack instead of a traditional torque converter, which owners say can feel less smooth at low speed. Several owners have filed complaints with NHTSA.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check for transmission and powertrain software updates. If the SUV ever loses drive at speed, get to safety and have it inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Shudder or grinding on sharp left turns
issues.sym: Vibration in the gas pedal and steering wheel, with a rumble or grinding from the right side, when accelerating through a tight left turn such as pulling into a driveway.
issues.why: Mazda found there isn't enough clearance between an engine mount's rubber stopper and its bracket, so they hit during hard turns.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 01-002-26. It's not usually a safety risk, but have it checked to rule out a drive axle or wheel bearing problem.

issues.t: Check engine light from the fuel vapor system
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with codes such as P0451, P2422, P2451 or P0441.
issues.why: Mazda issued a bulletin linking these codes to the fuel tank pressure sensor or the evaporative system shutter valve.
issues.next: Check that the fuel cap is tight. If the light stays on, have a dealer read the codes and follow bulletin SA-059-25.

issues.sym: A message saying "TCU Malfunction. Have the Vehicle Inspected" appears in the instrument cluster.
issues.why: Communication errors between the telematics unit, the connectivity unit and the emergency call unit. Mazda issued a bulletin for it.
issues.next: This is usually not urgent, but emergency call and connected features may not work. Ask the dealer about bulletin SA-060-25.

issues.t: Power liftgate won't open or reverses before closing
issues.sym: The power liftgate won't open, gets stuck partly latched, or reverses and reopens just before it closes.
issues.why: Software in the power liftgate control module can mishandle the latch and motor signals. Mazda released updated software.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the software update in bulletin 09-023-25.

issues.sym: A crack or tear in the outer edge of the driver or front passenger seat cushion, on the side by the door.
issues.why: Getting in and out repeatedly folds and rubs the seat bolster. Mazda changed to a tougher trim material.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin 09-022-25b while the SUV is under warranty.

issues.t: Engine shuts off at a stop and warning light comes on
issues.sym: The engine shuts off when you stop and a warning light comes on, or the engine keeps shutting off while coasting because auto start-stop can't be turned off.
issues.why: Owners report engine shut-offs tied to the auto start-stop system and the 12-volt battery. One owner's problem was fixed with a new battery after two visits.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Have the 12-volt battery and charging system tested and check that all software recalls are done. If the engine won't restart, put the SUV in Park with hazard lights on.

issues.sym: The blind spot warning lights up or beeps at highway speed when no car is beside you.
issues.why: An owner reported repeated false alerts that the dealer could not reproduce. Dirt or ice on the rear bumper sensors can also cause it.
issues.next: Keep the rear bumper corners clean. If it continues, ask the dealer to check the radar sensors and still look over your shoulder before changing lanes.

issues.t: Center screen goes black, reboots or CarPlay drops
issues.sym: The center display shows a double image or goes black, the system reboots at startup, voice control won't start, or Apple CarPlay and Android Auto disconnect.
issues.why: Software bugs in the Mazda Connect infotainment system. Mazda issued a software update.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to install the latest Mazda Connect software (bulletin 16-004-25).

issues.t: Can't shift to Neutral when the battery is dead
issues.sym: With a dead 12-volt battery the SUV won't start and stays locked in Park, so it can't be rolled or pushed.
issues.why: The CX-70's 8-speed automatic uses a hydraulic parking lock, so Neutral can only be selected while the engine is running (or the plug-in hybrid is in Ready). There is no manual release.
issues.next: Jump-start or charge the 12-volt battery first. If that fails, tell the tow company it needs a flatbed or wheel dollies and check the owner's manual for towing instructions.

issues.t: Rattle from the overhead map light
issues.sym: A rattle or buzz from the front ceiling light area, mostly on rough roads.
issues.why: Heat and vibration can deform the fastener holding the map light to its bracket. Mazda's fix adds a fabric pad to the headliner.

issues.t: Dust gets inside through the rear door gap
issues.sym: After driving on gravel or dusty roads, opening a rear door blows dust onto the seats and floor.
issues.why: There's a large gap where the rear and front doors meet at the bottom, and dusty air collects there while driving. Mazda says a production change is under study.
issues.next: Report it to the dealer under bulletin 09-031-25 and wipe the door edge after dusty trips.

issues.sym: The MyMazda app shows an error code and remote features such as lock or remote start stop working.
issues.why: Connected vehicle failures. Mazda issued a bulletin with the error codes and recovery steps.
issues.next: Restart the SUV and the app. If it continues, ask the dealer about bulletin SA-009-25a.
